blocks.body:
# 一级推荐：PORT-20

**ENGINEERING-CONDITIONAL OPTIMUM — NOT PHYSICS PROMOTED.** 窗口外保持 20 mm BPE、10 mm plastic、全部 BGO 与 cold-core Cu/Nb/Mu；仅给 BPE/plastic 切与既有 BGO/Al/Be 窗共注册的 **3.796 × 3.796 cm²** focused 方口。模型减重 **42.251 g**。KEEP-20 缺 full-envelope signal 分母，REMOVE 缺 matched total-background 分母；旧 `0.83069` 只是窄束 proxy。最终必须满足 matched 0/20 比较和 candidate-specific central + conservative `F3<=3e-5`；完整证据、共同物理图、矩阵、配置与 V0–V6 门见同目录 `REPORT.md`。

conflicts.decision: PORT-20; needs flight CAD, candidate S20 and matched total B

conflicts.positions: Not mission data; early BPE report corrected
conflicts.decision: Narrow-beam proxy only; needs full-envelope scatter/veto replay
Retain without credit; needs production Bq × exact-position coupling

conflicts.positions: Proxies fail/constrained; boundary test cannot decide
conflicts.decision: Freeze Cu/Nb/Mu; needs host-migration and engineering closure

candidates.physics_evidence: Direct-n moderation prior; no shown prompt reduction; no matched total B
candidates.tradeoffs: Official S20 excludes panel cost; baseline engineering

candidates.physics_evidence: Delayed benefit may be lost; prompt and migration unknown
candidates.tradeoffs: Potential signal recovery; plastic remains; about −33.6 kg and shell rework

candidates.physics_evidence: No candidate data; background cannot be linearly interpolated
candidates.tradeoffs: Possible partial signal recovery; about −16.8 kg; requalify shell

candidates.physics_evidence: Retains almost all BPE prior; known prompt leaks unchanged; no total B yet
candidates.tradeoffs: All sampled rays clear; −42.251 g; cold core frozen

candidates.physics_evidence: Host substitution shown; legal proxy only 10.22% D and low Neff
candidates.tradeoffs: Unknown scatter; mK thermal/structural hard risk

candidates.physics_evidence: Migration to Cu/Mu/L0; high coupling but sparse 1–2 event paths
candidates.tradeoffs: Magnetic hard gate; nominal signal neutral

materials.note: must not be folded into Copper

gates.decision: GO: single authority, manufacturable, clearance >=5.0 mm. NO-GO: authority or support/light/alignment conflict.
GO: 37194/37194 zero BPE/plastic chord, no overlap. NO-GO: clipping, alias or wrong geometry header.
GO: L95(S_PORT20/S_PORT0)>=0.98 and absolute S20. NO-GO: post-Be S20 reuse or lower bound <0.98.
GO: U95(P_PORT20/P_PORT0)<=1.10 and no aperture cell. NO-GO: ratio >1.10 or untallied migration.
GO: activity central <=0.90, U95<1, key host <=1.20. NO-GO: ancestry or sparse-stat gate fails.
GO: U95(B20/B0)<[L95(S20/S0)]². NO-GO: inequality fails or an unbounded family is omitted.
GO: central and conservative candidate-specific F3 gates pass. NO-GO: any gate/header/normalization audit fails.
